Class GameManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.game.GameManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelInterface
public class GameManager extends Object implements ModelInterface
Central coordinator for all active game sessions running on the Mesos server.

GameManager implements ModelInterface and is the single entry point through which the network layer (Socket / RMI handlers) interacts with the game logic. It maintains four internal registries:

  • activeGames — games currently in progress, keyed by game ID.
  • waitingGames — one lobby per player count, waiting for more players to join.
  • crashedGames — games loaded from persistent storage after a server crash, awaiting player reconnection before resuming.
  • playerToGame — reverse index from nickname to Game, used by all move methods to locate the correct game instance in O(1).

Thread safety: public methods synchronise on this for mutations to the shared registries and on the individual Game instance for move execution. This two-level locking strategy allows concurrent play in different games while serialising operations within the same game.

Advanced features:

  • When a non-null GameRepository is provided, every state change is persisted as a snapshot to support crash recovery via loadCrashedGames().
  • When a non-null LeaderboardRepository is provided, final scores are written to the database at game end and the updated leaderboard is appended to the delta list returned by takeCard(String, String).

      Constructs a fully-featured GameManager with optional repository support.

      nextGameId is initialised by scanning any snapshot files already on disk, preventing game-ID collisions after a server restart from overwriting existing snapshots.

      Parameters:

      leaderboardRepository - the persistence backend for game results; may be null to disable leaderboard support

  • Method Details

    • joinGame

      public JoinResult joinGame(int numPlayers, String nickname)
      Handles a player's request to join a game with the given number of players.

      The method covers three scenarios in order:

      1. Reconnect: if the nickname is already mapped to a crashed game, the player is reconnected and the current snapshot is returned immediately.
      2. Stale entry: if the nickname is mapped to a game that has already ended (turn > 10), the stale mapping is cleaned up and the player is treated as new.
      3. New join: the player is added to an existing waiting lobby for the given numPlayers, or a new lobby is created. Once the lobby is full, the game starts: the initial snapshot is saved and the returned JoinResult carries started = true.
      Specified by:
      joinGame in interface ModelInterface
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the desired game size (must be between 2 and 5 inclusive)
      nickname - the player's chosen display name
      Returns:
      a JoinResult containing the current game snapshot and whether the game has started
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the nickname is already in use in an active game
      IllegalArgumentException - if numPlayers is outside the range [2, 5]

    • takeCard

      public List<GameDelta> takeCard(String nickname, String cardId)
      Processes a card-take move for the given player and handles end-of-game logic.

      After delegating to Game.takeCard(Player, String), checks whether the game has ended (turn > 10). If so:

      1. Each player's final score is persisted to the LeaderboardRepository with a shared game_date timestamp.
      2. The updated leaderboard for the same player count is fetched and appended as a LeaderboardDelta to the returned list, so clients receive it in the same network message as the final game state.
      3. The game snapshot is deleted from the GameRepository since crash-recovery is no longer needed once the game has concluded.
      For non-final moves, only the updated snapshot is persisted.
      Specified by:
      takeCard in interface ModelInterface
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player taking the card
      cardId - the identifier of the card to take
      Returns:
      the list of GameDelta objects produced by the move; if the game ended, the list includes a trailing LeaderboardDelta
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the move violates game rules

    • loadCrashedGames

      public void loadCrashedGames()
      Loads all game snapshots persisted by the previous server run and registers them as crashed games awaiting player reconnection.

      Should be called once at server startup, before accepting any client connections. For each snapshot found, the corresponding Game is reconstructed via Game.fromSnapshot(GameSnapshot) and every player in it is added to the playerToGame reverse index, so that incoming join calls will trigger the reconnect flow rather than creating a new game.

    • handleClientDisconnect

      public List<String> handleClientDisconnect(String nickname)
      Cleans up all server-side state associated with a disconnecting client's game.

      Removes the game from all registries (activeGames, waitingGames, crashedGames) and evicts every player in that game from playerToGame — not only the disconnecting one — so no stale nickname mappings remain for the companions. The game snapshot is also deleted from the GameRepository. The returned list of companion nicknames is used by the network layer to notify the remaining players that their game has been terminated.

      Specified by:
      handleClientDisconnect in interface ModelInterface
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the disconnecting player
      Returns:
      the nicknames of the other players in the same game; empty if the player had not yet joined any game
